# Fix auth token expiry

## Context
Token expiry check in auth/middleware.ts uses `<` instead of `<=`, so tokens expiring exactly at the boundary pass validation.

## Changes
- Fix the comparison and extract an `isExpired()` helper.
- Migrate all 14 call sites to the new helper in one pass.
- Add boundary-case tests: expiry at, before, and after now.

## Verification
Run `npm test -- auth`; all suites green, plus a manual smoke login.
